changes: Also costs the Rytm less processing when samples loop forward (LOP ON) but none is set to PIPO.
Nothing you hear or see changes.
Documentation only: the test report names the author as Nathaniel Pavel (GitHub @npp1993).
Costs the Rytm less processing while LOP is OFF on every track.
Nothing you hear or see changes.
Ping Pong Loop has left the library: its PIPO loop and zero snap live here, unchanged.
No change on the unit.
Ping Pong Loop now lives here: LOP's third value PIPO plays the loop forward, then backward.
FUNC + turn on STA or END steps that point to the next zero crossing; S and E label their lines on the waveform.
Both play and look exactly as before. Remove Ping Pong Loop from your set: the two can't be installed together.
Previewing a sample (FUNC + YES in a sample list) plays it at normal speed again, whatever the track's RATE.
In 0.5.0 the preview was silent at RATE 0 (as on a sound saved on stock OS) and bent by an LFO on RATE.
The SMPL page shows values, not names: TUN, RATE, BR, LOOP (OFF, ON or PIPO) and LEV in one row.
The waveform is taller.
STA and END show as their lines; turn D for the sample list.
The header names a knob while it turns.
Renamed Improved SMPL.
The SMPL key always opens the waveform view; the knob-only view is gone.
The knobs still work there, each value showing while it turns.
FIN's knob is now RATE on every sound, and is called RATE everywhere, LFO destinations too.
No more SMP RATE row or knob tap: fine tuning lives on TUN.
RATE starts at +63 (normal speed) on a new or cleared sound.
Sounds saved with FIN at +0 now load stopped: turn RATE up to +63.
Renamed Fine Tune + Sample Rate.
TUN now turns 1 cent a step; press and turn for whole semitones. Reads like +3.07.
Fine tuning saves in the sound and plays the same on stock OS.
Tapping the knob between FIN and RATE no longer dips the speed or slides the pitch.
Uses less CPU when no sound has RATE on, leaving more time for the screen and pads.
No change to how RATE plays.
First library release, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74: FIN's knob becomes RATE, sound by sound.
RATE is pure sample speed, down to a stop and into reverse. Tap the knob, or check SMP RATE in SOUND SETTINGS, to switch.
Renamed Sample Playback Rate (was Sample RATE), and the module page now credits the author as Nathaniel Pavel (@npp1993). No change on the unit.
